II §2 p9.text: So now to empathy itself. Here, too, we are dealing with an act which is primordial as present experience though non-primordial in content. And this content is an experience which, again, can be had in different ways such as in memory, expectation, or in fancy.

transcription.original_text: So now to empathy itself. Here, too, we are dealing with an act which is primordial as present experience though non-primordial in content. And this content is an experience which, again, can be had in different ways such as in memory, expectation, or in fancy.

II §2 p9.alignment: These three complete sentences correspond to the original transition to empathy, the distinction of a primordial present act and non-primordial content, and the examples of memory, expectation and imagination. Primordial translates originär and fancy translates Phantasie.

Independently inspected German p. 9 and publisher-authorized English p. 10. All three sentences and punctuation match the print and preserve the distinction between the present primordial act and non-primordial content and examples. In different ways somewhat generalizes Vollzugsformen; it preserves the point. No meaningful typography within these sentences is omitted.
